title: The Lord Judges the Nations

questions.question: In those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem, I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of whom?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:2 (ESV): "I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat."

questions.question: They cast lots for my people, and traded a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for what?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:3 (ESV): "and traded a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine and drank it."

questions.question: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into what?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:10 (ESV): "Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears;"

questions.question: Let the weak say, "I am..."?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:10 (ESV): "let the weak say, 'I am a warrior.'"

questions.question: Multitudes, multitudes, in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
questions.explanation: Joel 3:14 (ESV): "Multitudes, multitudes, in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision."

questions.question: What have you to do with me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of where?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:4 (ESV): "What are you to me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia?"

questions.question: You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to whom, in order to remove them far from their own border?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:6 (ESV): "You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks,"

questions.question: Let the nations stir themselves up and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge whom?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:12 (ESV): "for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations."

questions.question: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is what?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:13 (ESV): "Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe."

questions.question: The Lord roars from Zion, and utters his voice from Jerusalem, and the heavens and the earth quake. But the Lord is a refuge to his people, a stronghold to the people of Israel.
questions.explanation: Joel 3:16 (ESV): "But the Lord is a refuge to his people, a stronghold to the people of Israel."

questions.question: I will return your payment on your own what?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:4 (ESV): "speedily and swiftly I will return your payment on your own head."

questions.question: Go in, tread, for the winepress is full. The vats overflow, for their evil is what?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:13 (ESV): "The vats overflow, for their evil is great."

questions.question: In that day the mountains shall drip sweet wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the streambeds of Judah shall flow with water; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of the Lord and water the Valley of whom?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:18 (ESV): "and a fountain shall come forth from the house of the Lord and water the Valley of Shittim."

questions.question: Egypt shall become a desolation and Edom a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the people of Judah, because they have shed what in their land?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:19 (ESV): "because they have shed innocent blood in their land."

questions.question: I will avenge their blood, blood I have not avenged, for the Lord dwells in where?
questions.explanation: Joel 3:21 (ESV): "for the Lord dwells in Zion."

key_verse_text: Multitudes, multitudes, in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
